name: moodreel
description: MoodReel – pick a film by how you feel.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @moodreel/server" "npm run dev -w @moodreel/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @moodreel/web && npm run build -w @moodreel/server
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
